name: formspec-bundle
description: Local esbuild of the @formspec-org/* packages. CDN bundlers split peer deps across separate /+esm URLs, so initFormspecEngine() in one bundle never initialises the WASM state held by the render bundle. We sidestep that by producing a single deduplicated bundle and emitting the WASM alongside it so import.meta.url resolves to a Django staticfiles path.
